beat: The Portuguese startup ecosystem — companies, founders, investors, institutions and the events where they meet — mapped on a graph built from primary sources that are frozen and hashed.

stories.title: Five names arrived and one left
stories.standfirst: Between 8 and 13 September the published speaker list for Startup Summit Lisbon 2026 went from 60 to 64. We have both copies and both hashes, which is the only reason anyone can now say that.

stories.title: Two names for three stages
stories.standfirst: The agenda calls them the Unicorn Stage and the Impact Stage. The AI-summary page calls them the Main Stage and the Startup Stage. Both are published by the same event on the same site today.
